ch: Jar by Jar starts with giving.
When you spend, tap I spent money.
One tap, and Pocket money covers it.
Talk it over makes a plain summary to send to your husband or wife, or print for the…
It works in dollars, shillings, pounds or euros.
Jar by Jar is the old envelope system, on your phone.
What you see here is an example family, the Walkers, so you can try everything on…
Tap any jar to open it.
At the bottom are two big buttons.
Money in is for a paycheck, a side job or a gift.
Move money between jars takes from one jar and puts it in another.
Start next month carries your plan over.
In Settings, pick dollars, shillings, pounds or euros.
Setting up Jar by Jar takes about ten minutes, once, at the kitchen table.
Step six: each time money comes in, tap Money in and type it.
Step eight: if a jar runs over, tap Cover it, and a jar with room makes up the difference.
Step ten: on the first of the month, tap Start next month.
